description: Bookmaker odds for a single event across markets (moneyline, spreads, totals). Odds are deeply nested by market, so the full structure is returned under `raw`. Get an event_id from betsapi_inplay or betsapi_upcoming first. Example: betsapi_event_odds({ event_id: "12345678", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: BetsAPI key (get one at betsapi.com, from ~$10/mo)

event_id.description: BetsAPI event id, from betsapi_inplay / betsapi_upcoming results

name: betsapi_event_odds
title: Betsapi Event Odds
